summary: Sinovac Biotech Ltd. filed a 6-K announcing an extension of the deadline for shareholders to submit payment instructions for a previously declared special cash dividend of US$55.00 per common share, payable to holders of record as of May 23, 2025. The submission deadline, originally December 31, 2025, and extended to June 30, 2026, is now further extended to December 31, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is provided beyond D.F. King Co., Inc. acting as Information Agent. The filing is a routine update on a capital return event rather than a new special situation. Watch for any further delays or changes in dividend payment execution.
